CLAUDE.md defines laws — it does NOT store state. All mutable data lives in memory/ · assets/ · pages/
Every entity gets an ID. IDs are used as cross-references everywhere — decisions in build.md, preferences in design.md, issues in state.md, assets in assets.md
Skills read context files before executing · Skills write output back to state files · MEMORY.md is always the entry point
